# Git

Page 1 of 1. Entries 1-7 of 7; 0 on other pages.

## Commit and publish changes

- `git-commit` — Inspect staged hygiene or prepare and commit selected changes.
- `git-pr` — Draft, create, or update a GitHub pull request.
- `git-sync` — Fetch, pull, push, or inspect branch synchronization.

## Manage local work

- `git-ignore` — Create or refine ignore rules while preserving scope, exceptions, and required files.
- `git-branch` — Create, switch, rename, or delete a local branch.
- `git-worktree` — Create, inspect, or remove parallel checkouts.
- `git-conflict` — Resolve and continue a merge, rebase, or cherry-pick.
